artifacts.summary: 2-phase plan appending one new Condition to the lean extension's plan-authoring gate-collision checklist (unusedArguments ledger-row remedy, narrow hand-insert route, ledger-row-vs-set_option decision) with its coupled index-entries.json metadata reconciled in the same phase, followed by a whole-tree redeploy phase.

memory_candidates.content: index-entries.json's line_count field has TWO enforcement surfaces with different severities, and reading only one of them misclassifies the obligation. validate-context-index.sh compares declared vs actual with a tolerance and calls log_warning (advisory). But check-extension-docs.sh's Rule R (check_line_count_accuracy) compares with EXACT string equality and no tolerance, reporting through index_truth_report as a FAIL -- and verify-deploy.sh gate 3 runs check-extension-docs.sh --quiet. So any edit that changes a context file's line count is commit-BLOCKING and its index_entries.json line_count must be reconciled in the SAME phase, not deferred. Related hazard: generate-context-line-counts.sh --write rewrites every mismatched entry across all extensions' index-entries.json files, so under concurrency it will silently pull a sibling task's line_count correction into your own commit when both entries live in the same extension's file -- hand-edit the single entry instead. deploy-headless.sh runs --write automatically before every deploy, so the same collateral appears again at deploy time.
